title: Adopt an official-only evidence contract
summary: Separate source authority, byte integrity and model validation. Community data may be exploratory only; canonical decision values require official confirmation.

title: Buy an odds archive before building anything else
summary: Purchase a historical odds archive that includes closing lines and, ideally, player-prop prices. Define 'closing line' as a single book and a single snapshot rule, in writing, before the first backtest.

title: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
summary: Ingest weekly final scores from the official schedule/game pages, then fit an opponent-adjusted rating (least-squares or Elo-style) with home-field advantage and margin variance estimated from the data instead of assumed.

title: Keep rewards recognition-only until approved
summary: No money, credits or stake handling until budget, jurisdiction and legal review are verified.

title: Secure permissioned odds and prop history
summary: Obtain written terms for historical/live prices, limits, timestamps, props, retention and derived data.

title: Add injury and personnel ablations instead of fixed penalties
summary: Instead of subtracting a fixed number of points for a missing starter, test the same model with and without the personnel features and report the difference with uncertainty.

title: Add injury/depth ablations, not fixed penalties
summary: Compare identical models with and without verified availability features using chronological holdouts.
impact: Tests whether personnel information adds skill

title: Automate build, citation and link gates
summary: Fail CI on missing row sources, broken local links, duplicate IDs, conflict markers or unsupported verified badges.

title: Automate immutable multi-day availability snapshots
summary: Capture the official report and club depth pages at least daily with retained hashes, so practice designations can be replayed as they were known. Today the site holds one capture, which cannot support backtesting.
impact: Turns a single snapshot into a time series

title: Automate verification in CI, including a live re-fetch
summary: Run the offline structural checks on every pull request and the live field-by-field re-fetch on a schedule and before deployment, publishing the result as an artifact and a page.
impact: Detects source drift without manual work

title: Build immutable official availability snapshots
summary: Scheduled capture of NFL injury reports, club depth pages and inactive evidence with raw hashes, timestamps and conflict flags.

title: Capture official inactive lists and snap counts
recommendation: Approve; it is the missing link
summary: Only 6 of 254 report rows carry a game designation, and no active list or snap share is captured. Without them a backup's replacement of a starter cannot be confirmed, only suspected.

title: Delay parlays until joint outcomes validate
summary: Require matched leg outcomes, direct joint calibration, game-cluster uncertainty and book payout rules.

title: Fix the two depth-parsing failures before widening coverage
summary: The Texans publish depth as an image and the Packers prepend jersey numbers. Number stripping plus storing the raw string recovers the Packers rows; the Texans image needs an authorized structured source, not transcription by eye.

title: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate
summary: Multiplying marginal probabilities is invalid under dependence. A combo may only be ranked when a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules are both available.

title: Model depth slots as groups, not a single starter
summary: 149 club/unit/position slots list more than one rank-1 player (three receivers at rank 1, three inside linebackers at rank 1). Treating column 1 as 'the starter' would fabricate a starter the club never named.

title: Publish a conflict-aware review queue
summary: Flag source lags, authority gaps, missing ranks and unsupported claims with official links and discovery actions.

title: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline
summary: Pre-register a simple team-strength model, freeze versions and record forecasts before kickoff.
impact: Creates a clean benchmark before complexity

title: Treat roster turnover as a first-class data event
summary: The Colts' Week 10 release documents two starting-receiver trades in the same article as its depth chart. Depth, availability and lineup evidence must be versioned against the last official roster event, not trusted as durable.
impact: Keeps depth evidence from going stale

title: Add durable snapshot storage and alerts
summary: Store immutable captures outside the static site, monitor freshness and alert on source/schema changes.

title: Expand to player-prop combinations last
summary: Require verified participation, prop settlement, joint dependence and held-out calibration before any combo signal.
impact: Addresses the hardest requested market safely

title: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate
summary: Rank by benchmark-relative Brier skill with a game-cluster lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment for the number of trials. Raw win rate and short-run ROI cannot distinguish skill from variance.
impact: Makes the leaderboard resistant to luck

title: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions
summary: Separate singles, game parlays, same-game parlays and prop combos; rank eligible strategies by benchmark-relative skill with uncertainty.

title: 2026 Kickoff & Declared Onside-Kick Regime Priors Filter
depends: Requires 2026 play-by-play special-teams dataset verification (see Q-11).
summary: Avoids systematic bias in originated game totals and 4th-quarter comeback win-probability curves.

title: Add a compliance page for NL licensing and NFL prop restrictions before any betting use
depends: Read Ksa rules and NFL primary policy
summary: Avoids using prohibited or unlicensed markets

title: Add a control baseline (random picks; favorites only) to every leaderboard run
summary: Separates skill from luck

title: Add a drift alarm to every scraper
summary: Pin each parser to expected row counts and required fields; fail the build loudly when a field goes missing rather than publishing a blank.

title: Add a per-team view: starters out, replacements named, net injury count
summary: Quick team-level decision view

title: Add a suggestion-review page with a comparison view
summary: Ship a review page that shows every suggestion with its score, its blocking questions, what happens if it is skipped, and a side-by-side comparison of any two selected items.

title: Add an announced-starter evidence field (not an inferred replacement)
recommendation: Every populated value links to a specific dated article, and the field is absent where no announcement exists.
summary: The blank replacement columns are correct for the report page, but the NFL does publish dated starter changes for Lock, McCord and Brissett (VR-24, VR-25; VQ-05).

title: Add an official depth-chart register with date and source per row
depends: Identify an official depth-chart source (not found yet)
summary: Required to flag backups replacing starters on offense and defense

title: Add search and filter to each table page (already started on Injuries)
summary: Easier review of 254+ rows

title: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons (for Q06)
summary: Only way to test whether designations change outcomes

title: Automated Official-Domain Allowlist & Empty-Cell Integrity Pre-Commit Hook
depends: Approve official domain allowlist policy (see Q-12).
summary: Guarantees every future commit enforces semantic domain-to-topic matching and blocks inferred fill-ins for missing data.

title: Automated link and verification check on every build (in place: scripts/check.mjs)
recommendation: Implemented (verification tooling only, required by the brief; no content change)
summary: Stops broken links and rows without sources

title: Calibrate what "Questionable" means empirically instead of using old percentages
summary: Official text gives no percentages

title: Cap position-value weights at what can be defended
summary: Publish the weights as an editable parameter table, show the index under a low/high weight set, and label every index value as assumption-driven.

title: Capture the reserve list so 'not listed' never means 'available'
recommendation: No feature can treat a reserve-list player as available.
summary: Malik Willis is absent from the weekly report because he is on injured reserve, not because he is healthy (VR-25; VQ-06).

title: Choose one licensed odds source with opening and closing timestamps
summary: Needed for any line analysis or CLV

title: Correct the Colts depth rows and the Packers coverage error
recommendation: Player-name validation passes for every Colts row and the Packers club appears with its published chart.
summary: One Colts row merges two players, another duplicates a player, and Green Bay is published as unparseable although it publishes a full text table (VR-14, VR-18, VR-19, VR-20).

title: Do not price parlays or props until leg-level correlation is estimated
summary: Block ST-04 to ST-10 at gate G0 until a leg-level dataset exists and pairwise rho is estimated per market cluster.

title: Flag stale depth rows against the official transactions log
recommendation: No depth row is displayed as current when a later dated transaction exists, without an explicit stale badge.
summary: Baltimore still publishes Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley at QB after both went on injured reserve and a replacement was traded in (VR-17, VR-26; VQ-07).

title: Freeze a rule before it sees data (pre-registration)
summary: Commit the rule text, the sample window and the gates to git before the evaluation window opens. The commit hash is the registration.

title: Interactive Offense vs. Defense Matchup Deficiency Matrix (1st–4th String)
depends: Requires multi-source player ID mapping across nfl.com/injuries/, club depth charts, and 53-man rosters (see Q-05).
summary: Surfaces immediate trench and coverage mismatches (e.g., WR1 facing promoted 2nd/3rd-string CB, or EDGE1 facing 2nd/3rd-string OT/LG) on one screen.

title: Joint-Simulation Correlation Explorer with Confidence Intervals
depends: Requires aligned historical play-by-play and settled prop line archive (see Q-06, Q-07).
summary: Prevents originating parlays or player prop combos on spurious historical correlations by requiring lower-bound confidence edge.

title: Keep a written record of every rejected idea and every trial count
summary: Log every strategy variant, including failures, with its timestamp, in a file that is append-only and committed.

title: Keep the site analysis-only; no picks or recommendations
summary: Reduces risk and keeps the decision with the owner

title: Label the REG9 capture by its body week, not its document title
recommendation: Any citation of REG9 shows week 9 from the heading plus the observed title text, or shows a conflict badge.
summary: The REG9 page's document title says Week 10 while its heading and first game say Week 9, so a citation keyed on the title mis-dates the capture (VR-02).

title: Make a failed parse look different from a clean result
recommendation: The build fails when a scheduled club yields zero parsed rows without a no-injury marker on the page.
summary: A zero-row club and a genuinely injury-free club render identically today; that is how Seattle and Cincinnati passed review (VQ-03).

title: Make closing-line value the headline metric, not ROI
summary: Rank primarily on mean CLV in probability units with a confidence interval; treat realised ROI as a secondary diagnostic only.

title: Point-in-Time Snapshot Ledger for Injuries, Depth Charts & Inactives
depends: Confirm NFL.com & club website terms of use or procure commercial feed license (see Q-02).
summary: Prevents lookahead leakage when backtesting originated lines and preserves exact pre-kickoff replacement certainty.

title: Populate the three missing Lions game-status designations
recommendation: Every player listed Out/Questionable/Doubtful in the official article shows that designation, with a citation to the article. [DONE 2026-11-16, arena/f5f99ff0-nfl3] All three Lions rows show Out on the published pages, each traceable to the official Week 10 article and the 2026-11-16T06:31Z hash-backed capture of the official report; the acceptance test passes.
summary: Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed are published with a blank game-status cell while the official article lists all three as Out (VR-08, VR-12).

title: Pre-Registered Strategy Registry & Deflated Multiple-Testing Audit Log
depends: Requires agreement on minimum effective sample size and alpha threshold before first backtest run (see Q-08).
summary: Forces every strategy trial—including failed parameter sweeps—into the denominator of False Discovery Rate (FDR) and Deflated Sharpe checks.

title: Pre-register each strategy (definition frozen before results are seen)
summary: Prevents result-chasing

title: Pre-register the personnel ablation and its sample threshold
recommendation: The pre-registration is published and dated earlier than the first result table.
summary: Without a frozen threshold, a '2nd-string dropoff' result is a fishing expedition (VQ-12, VQ-13).

title: Promote the verification register to a build-time contract
recommendation: A structural break in a source shows up as a failed verification row in the deployed build, not as an empty table.
summary: Nothing prevents a future capture from silently breaking a claim that was verified by hand today (VQ-16).

title: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff instead of a static snapshot
summary: Store each weekly snapshot and render a diff column (rank change, rating change, availability change).

title: Publish every model total twice until one wins
summary: Keep both estimators visible with the gap column, and only collapse to one after a walk-forward comparison.

title: Publish the unverified items as a first-class page, not a footnote
summary: A dedicated Flagged for Review page listing every unverified value, every irregularity, the source links, and what would clear it.

title: Re-capture and republish the Week 10 injury tables
recommendation: Every club section in the rebuilt table has the same player count as the live report, and no club shows 'No Injuries Reported' unless the page says so.
summary: Published counts are stale: 254 rows and 4 no-injury sections versus 279 rows and 2 sections live; Seattle and Cincinnati are shown as injury-free while listing 15 and 4 players (VR-04, VR-05, VR-06, VR-07).

title: Reject: deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary
summary: Proposed shortcut for SG-05: infer starters from roster attributes on the official roster page.

title: Reject: ranking strategies by season-long ROI
summary: Proposed alternative to SG-03: rank purely on realised return over the season.

title: Represent shared and empty depth slots faithfully
recommendation: No consumer of the data can compute 'starter = rank 1' without handling a multi-player slot.
summary: Seattle puts two players in one slot and Washington leaves a slot empty; both are currently indistinguishable from a ranked list (VR-21, VR-23; VQ-08).

title: Resolve the depth-order source before building the backup-deficiency feature
summary: Evaluate two routes in order: (a) per-club official depth chart pages, verified club by club; (b) derive depth from snap counts if an official snap-count source exists. Do not build the feature until one route is verified for all 32 clubs.

title: Score injury-designation reliability before using it as a feature
summary: Join several seasons of designations to the official inactive lists and measure the play rate per designation with confidence intervals. Only then decide whether the label becomes a model feature.

title: Settle the market-data decision before any line work
recommendation: A written decision exists either way; the site states which one is in force.
summary: No originated line can be scored without permissioned historical prices and a settlement contract (VR-28; VQ-10, VQ-11).

title: Snapshot the nfl.com injury report every Wed, Thu and Fri and keep a dated history
depends: Scheduled job (manual or CI) and storage in repo
summary: Lets us see Questionable→Out changes and practice trends (DNP→LP→FP)

title: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
summary: Protects out-of-sample testing

title: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer
summary: Keep the public site to derived analysis (indices, ratios, model output, links to the official page) and hold raw row-level data in a private store until the terms are read.

title: Stadium Roof/Surface & NWS Hourly Wind/Precipitation Overlay
depends: Requires stadium coordinate registry and international weather source selection (see Q-10).
summary: Prevents totals and passing-prop mispricing by coupling NWS forecast grids with official 90-minute stadium roof designations.

title: Treat the injury report as a timestamped series, not a weekly snapshot
summary: Capture the report daily from Wednesday to kickoff with the fetch timestamp, then measure how designations evolve.

title: Two-Stage Skill Leaderboard (Proper-Score Qualification -> Prospective CLV/ROI Escrow)
depends: Requires legal/compliance sign-off on competition reward structure in applicable jurisdictions (see Q-01, Q-09).
summary: Aligns incentives strictly with calibrated probabilistic skill (Brier Skill Score + Closing Line Value) over multi-week prospective samples.

title: Unified Root Navigation Bridging Parallel Session Workspaces
depends: Requires cross-session lock release or owner approval per COORDINATION.md.
summary: Gives human reviewers a single canonical entry bar comparing all session audits without losing any session's verified evidence.

title: Use snap counts as the starter proxy when the depth chart is unavailable
summary: Gives a measurable starter/backup split

title: Vig-Free Market Consensus vs. Originated Fair-Line Decomposition View
depends: Requires licensed historical & live sportsbook quote archive and jurisdiction clearance (see Q-01, Q-03).
summary: Separates true pricing divergence (origination alpha) from operator vig/margin before any bet structure is considered.
